name: AI incidents & governance
value: EU AI Act duties 2 Dec; deepfake apps
summary: Hundreds of apps found hiding abusive deepfake tools; EU AI Act duties widen on 2 Dec
state: Researchers found hundreds of apps on major app stores were part of a network hiding sexually abusive deepfake tools, AppleInsider reported on 2 Nov. Deepfake ads were widespread in the US midterms (Washington Sun). Further EU AI Act obligations apply from 2 Dec. No AI-enabled attack on critical infrastructure had been reported as of 5 Nov.
for_you: Be cautious of unverified audio, video and images, especially around elections.

sources.title: AppleInsider — Hundreds of AI apps hid sexually abusive deepfake tools
Washington Sun — Deepfake ads erupted in 2026

why: Powerful AI systems are being deployed faster than safeguards; serious incidents or governance breakdowns carry systemic risk.
drivers: Model releases, misuse incidents, regulation, compute controls, deepfakes in elections.
